_note: Verified 2026-07-27. Companies House 14293054 lists a single director, HOARE, Lancelot Theodore Richard Falconer, appointed 2022-08-12, confirming co-founder and CEO Lancelot Hoare and the 2022 founding. The GBP2.5m seed round led by Raw Ventures and Ada Ventures (with angels, including Anton Buzdalin), announced 16 July 2026, and the servicing of Lime's roughly 50,000-bike London e-bike fleet are from BikeBiz and ZAG Daily, both dated 16 July 2026; BikeBiz names all three co-founders (Hoare CEO, Nikita Baranov COO, Daniel Bursztynski CTO). The on-demand mobile bike-mechanic service across London is confirmed from the live site tyred.io. Public sources only; no contact data.
one_liner: Tyred is a London company that sends bike mechanics to riders on demand and services shared e-bike fleets, including roughly 50,000 of Lime's bikes in London, while building a connected 'ownership' platform that bundles bike repairs, maintenance, insurance, warranty, and finance.
one_liner_source: https://tyred.io (on-demand mobile mechanic service) and https://bikebiz.com/tyred-raises-2-5-million-to-build-an-ai-powered-ownership-platform-for-cycling/ (Lime fleet and ownership platform); both verified 2026-07-27
headcount_source: No public headcount figure; qualitative estimate of the core team for a 2022-founded seed startup that has raised GBP2.5m and is hiring engineers. Its field mechanic operation is larger (100,000+ bikes serviced in the past year and a roughly 50,000-bike Lime fleet in London) and is likely partly a contractor network, so this bucket reflects the core company only and is uncertain (BikeBiz and ZAG Daily, 16 July 2026).
